name: Configuration Auditor
description: Audits an existing life sciences CRM implementation for configuration gaps, compliance issues, and optimization opportunities. Runs validation rules systematically and produces a scored report.

phases.name: Scope & Inventory
phases.description: Identify which modules are deployed and what countries are in scope.
checklist: User count and license types documented
Custom objects and fields inventoried (beyond standard modules)

phases.name: Validation Sweep
phases.description: Run all applicable validation rules against current configuration.

scoring.warn: Rule partially passes — non-critical gap found
scoring.fail: Rule fails — configuration gap could cause issues
scoring.critical: Rule fails on a compliance-critical item — must fix before production use

checklist: Sample Management validation rules executed (if module deployed)
Consent Management validation rules executed (if module deployed)
Country-specific rules executed for each country in scope
Each finding categorized: pass / warn / fail / critical

phases.name: Gotcha Check
phases.description: Cross-reference deployed configuration against known gotchas.
checklist: Each deployed module checked against gotcha database
Each applicable gotcha flagged as: mitigated / at-risk / impacted

phases.name: Report & Recommendations
phases.description: Produce the audit report with prioritized findings and remediation steps.

report_format.executive_summary: Overall health score and top 3 risks
report_format.findings: Grouped by severity (Critical → High → Medium → Low)
report_format.each_finding: Description, evidence, impact, remediation steps, effort estimate
report_format.appendix: Validation rule results, gotcha check results, raw data
